basics.label: Software Developer
summary: Living north of Copenhagen with my wife and daughters.
Lifetime learner and polyglot software craftsman with a great love for physical training, music and nature.
A long experience implementing and teaching agile methodologies and principles.
With over 25 years of experience on software development, I span a variety of different technologies, paradigms and programming languages.
I have had many roles within and outside IT, such as developer, coach, teacher, architect, project manager, scrum master, product owner and team lead
As I still do software development, I keep up with new technologies and therefore thrive in environments and cultures who value competences, innovation and creativity.

experiences.title: Business Consultant (Data Engineering)
experiences.summary: Build and run Python data pipelines that combine agreement data from four source systems, apply business rules and decide which of more than 4,000 business customers get which notification letters. The pipelines have reduced errors and uncovered data variations nobody knew about, and each run produces a report that shows the business what happened at every step. Also subject matter expert on a new project, covering data and technical questions and helping define the AI-assisted development process (AI SDLC) for the teams.

da.summary: Bygger og driver Python-datapipelines, der samler aftaledata fra fire kildesystemer, anvender forretningsregler og afgør, hvilke af over 4.000 erhvervskunder der får hvilke varslingsbreve. Pipelines har nedbragt antallet af fejl og afdækket datavariationer, som ingen kendte til, og hver kørsel giver en rapport, der viser forretningen, hvad der skete i hvert trin. Desuden fagekspert på et nyt projekt med fokus på data og teknik og med til at definere den AI-understøttede udviklingsproces (AI SDLC) for teamene.

print.lede: Senior software engineer north of Copenhagen, with years behind me as architect, agile coach and tech lead.
profile: For twenty-five years I've been writing software, and I still write code. Right now I build pipelines that decide which customers get which letters, and I help work out how development teams should use AI in their work.

Along the way I've led agile transformations and co-founded three software companies. I've used languages such as Java, C#, Elixir and Python in production, so I tend to pick the tool that fits the problem, not the one I know best.

earlier.text: Product owner, Scrum Master and architect at Lokalebasen.dk and MP Pension; delivery manager at Widex; developer and architect at Nykredit, Forca, Omada, XponCard, Nokia and Ericsson; co-founder of Macellum; and a deployment with the Danish Defence (ISAF, Afghanistan).

da.lede: Senior softwareudvikler nord for København, med mange år som arkitekt, agil coach og tech lead bag mig.
profile: Jeg har skrevet software i femogtyve år, og jeg skriver stadig kode. Lige nu bygger jeg pipelines, der afgør, hvilke kunder der får hvilke breve, og jeg er med til at finde ud af, hvordan udviklingsteams skal bruge AI i deres arbejde.

Undervejs har jeg stået i spidsen for agile transformationer og været med til at stifte tre softwarevirksomheder. Jeg har brugt sprog som Java, C#, Elixir og Python i produktion, så jeg vælger det værktøj, der passer til problemet, og ikke bare det, jeg kender bedst.

earlier.text: Product owner, Scrum Master og arkitekt hos Lokalebasen.dk og MP Pension; delivery manager hos Widex; udvikler og arkitekt hos Nykredit, Forca, Omada, XponCard, Nokia og Ericsson; medstifter af Macellum; og udsendt med Forsvaret (ISAF, Afghanistan).
